# What xtermjs (@xterm/headless 6.0.0) sent in the legacy mode, in hex, for each event.
press left 3,2	1b5b3c303b343b334d
release left 3,2	1b5b3c303b343b336d
press right 3,2	1b5b3c323b343b334d
release right 3,2	1b5b3c323b343b336d
scroll up 3,2	1b5b3c36343b343b334d
scroll down 3,2	1b5b3c36353b343b334d
